on September 24, 2026. `source-receipts.json` retains the source locations,
timestamps, ETags and byte hashes.

The live Regulations.gov API also returned `docketId: null` for each comment
and its explicit parent document. The comments contain substantive responses

docket value. The mirror's directory name does not establish a source docket.
The fixtures retain `commentOnDocumentId` and `commentOn` as source evidence.
